blocks.text: Water moves between the sea, the air and the land. The sun heats water, and it rises as invisible vapour. This is called evaporation.
High in the air the vapour cools and turns into tiny drops. Many drops together form a cloud.

blocks.alt: Simple drawing of the water cycle: sun, sea, cloud and rain

blocks.text: When the drops in a cloud grow heavy, they fall as rain, hail or snow. The water then flows back to rivers and the sea, and the cycle starts again.
